import idautils, idc
out=[]
cands=[s for s in idautils.Strings() if str(s).strip().lower()=='mesh']
out.append('mesh 字符串命中 %d 个' % len(cands))
for s in cands[:6]:
    out.append('str %s' % hex(s.ea))
    for xr in idautils.XrefsTo(s.ea):
        f=idc.get_func_attr(xr.frm, idc.FUNC_ATTR_START)
        out.append('   xref %s  in %s' % (hex(xr.frm), hex(f) if f and f!=-1 else '?'))
print('
'.join(out[:60]))
